verdict_rules: supported on vault: vault effect with the predicted sign AND (vault CI90 excludes zero OR (full CI90 excludes zero AND vault point inside it AND random-filter pct >= 90)); discovery only: discovery effect with the predicted sign and CI90 excluding zero while the vault does not; not testable at this n: < 8 affected vault A nights; harmful: full effect negative with CI90 excluding zero; else no effect.  'Affected' for the n rule = the vault nights the rule touches (grade or P&L changed, every grade the rule acts on; n_affected_A is reported alongside).  Free rules additionally carry the no-harm criterion (flagged nights' net P&L <= 0 on discovery AND vault).  The LAB_DESIGN 2.7 degeneracy guard (>= 2.5 A nights per month on discovery) is reported per rule.

H5.rule: after-hours print veto: |post_ret| > 0.3% or megacap_earnings_tonight == 1 -> NO EDGE (all grades)
H5.parameters: |post_ret| > 0.003 (single, pre-registered); megacap flag from the calendar
H5.predicted: flagged nights avg -40..-50; A nights lost <= 3; +1.5..+2 pts/night over all nights; no-harm criterion: flagged net P&L <= 0 on discovery and on the vault
H5.verdict_why: vault sign as predicted; vault CI excludes zero; vault +17.9 CI [2.8, 35.6], full +6.9 CI [2.2, 12.7]
H5.note: the flagged nights already carry the 4-pt event cost in the baseline; 2025-09-16 (splice, fake post_ret) is excluded; the backlog expected <= 3 A nights lost and ~8-10 flagged discovery nights
